description: This file defines the AccountChooserViewHolder class used in an Android application to display account information within a RecyclerView. It binds account data to UI components and handles user interactions.

classes.name: AccountChooserViewHolder
classes.description: A RecyclerView ViewHolder that binds account data to UI elements and handles user interactions for account selection.

methods.name: AccountChooserViewHolder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ViewHolder with the provided binding.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds an Account object to the UI components and sets up a click listener to handle account selection.
